summary:
Scoped PASS for the automated port task at source digest 6ef3e2af1bf51ab5ffc051b67b311a2a3e889da805d322913d19fe02deb9af12. It rests on tester evidence only. I did not run any check, and I did not read web/, platform/ or tests/ source.

What I did: I read loop/acceptance.md, loop/agents.yaml, the integration coder handoff, the build-01 reviewer handoff, the build-03 and rendering-01 tester handoffs, the rendering-01 verification result.json, and the first 250 lines of the run's state.json. I opened no other handoffs, process.json files or verification results, and I did not read the rest of state.json. I have no execution tool, so I did not run tests/test_browser.py, tests/browser.mjs, tests/test_audio.py or tests/test_loop.py.

Evidence I read:
- The rendering-01 verification (artifacts/runs/loop-20261105T005309Z-73a58c79/rendering-01-7976e2ef/tester/verification-decf9f55b4fe/result.json) is PASS at the task digest. Build exited 0 in 4.2s and tests exited 0 in 20.0s.
- The build-03 tester handoff reports a fresh verification, build-03-739c40e3/tester/verification-c2ca2bd026bb, also PASS at the same digest.
- The integration coder handoff says the build-02, build-03, wad-01, input-01 and rendering-01 verification results all show PASS at this digest. I checked only the rendering-01 result myself; the coder's claim covers the other four.
- state.json lists build, rendering, input and wad as completed. It was still RUNNING when I read it. The integration task was at attempt 1, so it had no completed result yet.

Unresolved defects and risks. None is a confirmed defect.
- The verification results record only return codes and timings. Emscripten 4.0.18 is inferred from the successful build. I saw no raw build log and no `emcc --version` output.
- The 4-5s build time is short and unexplained. It may be a cached or incremental build.
- build.sh passes -w, which hides compiler warnings. That script is human-owned.
- No test checks colour channel order. A swapped R/B would still pass the lit-pixel check (per the rendering tester).
- The pacing and blur checks are loose or synthetic.
- The tests command is described only as the "protected browser and audio acceptance suite", and I did not confirm that it includes tests/test_loop.py. Run tests/test_loop.py separately. It uses fixtures and is not evidence of real autonomous repair or resumption.
- Build task history: build-01 got a reviewer FAIL at an older digest (bf73c249) because no build evidence existed. Its tester attempt was charged a reserved $2.00 with actual cost unknown. This is consistent with the acceptance rules on interrupted runs.

Not established by the automated checks, and not performed (manual evidence still needed):
- Real door and switch activation, OS focus transitions, physical speakers and musical fidelity, save persistence, and mouse aiming. A manual playthrough has not been done and must not be invented.

Full-assignment items, not performed or not established:
- Autonomous repair of two blind teammate or instructor regressions.
- Live resumption.
- Accountability, design rationale and reflection write-ups.
- The teammate exercise is NOT PERFORMED, at the user's explicit request.
- Historical token and cost usage is unknown.

This PASS covers the scoped automated port only. It is not full capstone acceptance.
